evidence.detail: colors tablesorter parser `is` function checks `$td.find('span.mana').length > 0` to detect color cells
colors_html() generates `<span class='stacked-bar mana-{color}'>` — spans have class `mana-W` etc. but NOT the bare `mana` class, so `span.mana` selector returns 0 for all colored decks
Only the colorless fallback span has class `mana` (`<span class='stacked-bar mana'>`), so detection works only for colorless decks

triage.fix_sketch: In shared_web/static/js/pd.js line 134, change the `is` function to `return $td.hasClass('contains-mana-bar') || $td.find('span.mana').length > 0;` — the td already has class `contains-mana-bar` (editarchetypes.mustache:18), making detection reliable without touching Python.
triage.notes: Alternative fix is to add class `mana` to colored spans in prepare.py:253 but that risks CSS side-effects; the JS-only fix is safer.
